findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "domain-health" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email_auth, check_ssl, full_domain_report · Private data: check_email_auth, check_ssl, check_domain_registration · Public sink: check_email_auth, check_domain_registration, full_domain_report · Destructive: full_domain_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email_auth, check_ssl, full_domain_report · Private data: check_email_auth, check_ssl, check_domain_registration · Public sink: check_email_auth, check_domain_registration, full_domain_report · Destructive: full_domain_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
